name: Diane Hargrave
flavor: Took two regional carriers off the brink and sold one of them. Opens doors that don't open for operators, and knows exactly which quarter to open them in.

name: Marcus Oyelaran
flavor: Twenty years running control centres. Believes most delays are decisions, not weather, and reschedules a rotation faster than anyone can explain why it broke.

name: Priya Raghunathan
flavor: Came up through the cabin and never stopped thinking like it. Rewrote a legacy carrier's onboard standards and made the crew like the new ones better.

name: Errol Vance
flavor: A licensed engineer who still reads the defect log himself. Reckons a well-kept airframe owes you nothing and a neglected one takes it out of your schedule.

name: Simone Adeyemi
flavor: Structured aircraft debt for a decade before deciding she would rather spend it than arrange it. Finds money in the working capital nobody else was looking at.

name: Tomas Lindqvist
flavor: Built a low-cost carrier's network one town at a time: the travel agents, the local papers, the chamber of commerce. New routes fill faster when he's already told the town they're coming.
